emergency_numbers.label: Police
emergency_numbers.note_en: Operators may not speak English. State location first.

emergency_numbers.label: Fire & Ambulance
emergency_numbers.note_en: Say "kyūkyūsha" (きゅうきゅうしゃ) for ambulance. Operators may not speak English.

emergency_numbers.label: Japan Helpline — English 24/7
emergency_numbers.note_en: English-speaking operators. Can conference-translate with 110/119. Use this first.

emergency_numbers.label: AMDA Medical Info — English
emergency_numbers.note_en: Free multilingual medical phone line — helps find a doctor and can interpret. Mon–Fri 10:00–16:00, closed public holidays. Toll-free from a Japanese line: 0120-339-266.

embassy.address_jp: 〒102-0084 東京都千代田区二番町3
embassy.after_hours: Consular section direct line: 03-3264-0197. Closed on Israeli and Japanese holidays — during this trip that is Tue Nov 3 (Culture Day).

hospital.address: 〒101-8643 東京都千代田区神田和泉町1
hospital.note: Phone before you go — the hospital asks every emergency patient to call first, and may be at capacity. ¥8,800 off-hours surcharge, waived if they judge you need treatment. English help finding a doctor: Tokyo Himawari 03-5285-8181, daily 9:00–20:00. Nurse advice line: #7119 / 03-3212-2323, 24h.
hospital.hours: Emergency reception 24h — at night, internal medicine and surgery only. Outpatient Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00, Sat 9:00–12:30; closed Sun & holidays.
hospital.distance: 7 min walk from JR Akihabara Showa-dori exit — the hotel is 1 min from the same station.

pharmacy.name: Welcia Akihabara Ekimae (ウエルシア秋葉原駅前店)
pharmacy.location: BiTO AKIBA 1F, Sotokanda 1-18-19 — at Akihabara Station, Electric Town exit side.
pharmacy.hours: Store open 24 hours. Dispensing counter Mon–Sat 9:00–21:00, Sun 10:00–14:00 & 15:00–19:00; closed public holidays.
pharmacy.note: Outside those dispensing hours it is over-the-counter only.

hospital.address: 〒600-8558 京都市下京区塩小路通西洞院東入東塩小路町841-5
hospital.note: Call the emergency line 075-361-1351 — not 075-361-1360, which is appointments only, weekdays 9:00–17:00. The hospital's own site runs in English, Chinese and Korean. Nurse advice line: #7119 / 0570-00-7119, 24h, free. ⚠ Kyoto City's after-hours clinic at Nijō has no adult internal medicine on weekday nights, so this hospital is the first call.
hospital.hours: Emergency reception 24h (internal medicine, surgery, cardiology, neurosurgery). Outpatient 9:00–12:30 & 14:00–16:00; closed Sun & holidays.
hospital.distance: Kyoto Station Central Exit — the hospital's own directions walk you there from the same gate the hotel uses, past the Central Post Office.

pharmacy.name: Kokumin Drug, Kyoto Porta (コクミンドラッグ 京都ポルタ店)
pharmacy.location: Kyoto Porta B1F — the underground mall on Kyoto Station's north side, the hotel's own side.
pharmacy.hours: Shop 7:00–22:30 daily. Dispensing counter Mon–Fri 9:00–14:00 & 15:00–20:00, Sat 9:00–14:00 & 15:00–18:00; closed Sun & holidays.
pharmacy.note: Over-the-counter medicine is available across the whole 7:00–22:30 window. The map pin drops on Porta itself — B1F is one connected level and the drugstore zone is signposted from every entrance.

hospital.name_jp: 広島市立広島市民病院
hospital.note: Outside opening hours, report to the emergency reception in the East Building, 1F. Nurse advice line: #7119 / 082-246-2000, 24h. For an evening illness there is also Senda-machi Night Emergency Centre (千田町夜間急病センター), 082-504-9990, reception 19:30–22:30 daily, adults 15+ — they require you to phone before coming. ⚠ The hospital nearest the hotel, Futaba-no-sato (5 min from the Shinkansen exit), runs outpatient clinics Mon–Fri only, so it is shut on both nights of this stay.
hospital.distance: Tram from JR Hiroshima Station, ~16 min to Kamiyachō-higashi, then ~7 min on foot; the hotel is 3 min from the station's south exit. ⚠ Last tram from the station is 22:01 (line 1) / 22:31 (line 2) — later than that, take a taxi from the station rank and show the address above.

pharmacy.name: Matsumoto Kiyoshi, ekie (マツモトキヨシ エキエ広島店)
pharmacy.location: ekie 1F, inside Hiroshima Station on the south side — behind the same South Exit the hotel lists as a 3 min walk.
pharmacy.note: The map pin drops on the ekie mall inside the station, not on the shop front.

show_to_staff_cards.en: Please help, please call an ambulance
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 助けてください、救急車を呼んでください
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: tasukete kudasai, kyūkyūsha wo yonde kudasai

show_to_staff_cards.en: I don't speak Japanese. Is there someone who speaks English?
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 日本語が話せません。英語を話せる方はいますか？
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: nihongo ga hanasemasen. eigo wo hanaseru kata wa imasu ka?

show_to_staff_cards.en: I feel sick. I want to go to a hospital.
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 具合が悪いです。病院に行きたいです。
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: guai ga warui desu. byōin ni ikitai desu.

show_to_staff_cards.en: I'm staying here. I want to return to my hotel.
show_to_staff_cards.jp: ここに泊まっています。ホテルに戻りたいです。
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: koko ni tomatte imasu. hoteru ni modoritai desu.

show_to_staff_cards.en: I'm lost. I want to go to this place. [show your Maps screen]
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 道に迷いました。この場所に行きたいです。
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: michi ni mayoimashita. kono basho ni ikitai desu.

show_to_staff_cards.jp: 警察を呼んでください

pharmacy_tip: Japanese pharmacies (ドラッグストア) sell OTC painkillers, cold medicine, bandages, and stomach remedies. For anything prescription-strength, you need a hospital. Show the pharmacist what's wrong — many understand basic English medical terms.
